goal: Feature flag review: flags with an owner, a default and a removal date.
use: Feature flag review: flags with an owner, a default and a removal date. Use when a feature is behind a flag or a flag is added.

steps.note: List the flags. Find each flag check and its default value.
Check ownership. Each flag needs a named owner.
Check removal. Flag flags older than their planned removal date.
Check both paths. Test the code with the flag on and off.
Report. Each flag with its owner, default, age and the risk of each path.
